title: Archiwum 60 s — ZE13 03 — usuwam blokady
description: Poza timeline’em wersji 42 s. Zachowany projekt wcześniejszego wariantu. Kontrplan Halinki. Zwyczajnie wyjaśnia swój rytuał, nadal trzymając szałwię na spodku w lewej dłoni i telefon w prawej. Dialog do nagrania: Halinka: „Usuwam blokady.” Etap projektu: zaprojektowany placeholder; Start Frame i take nie zostały wygenerowane.

prompts.image:
Create exactly one photorealistic cinematic 16:9 START FRAME, target 1920x1080. Natural diffuse daylight through the missing roof, restrained 35mm texture, real skin and materials. Mandatory references in attachment order:
Image 1: shot:ze13-01-oczyszczanie, established scene geography, props, light and costume continuity; change the framing/action only as specified below.
Images 2 and 3: character:halinka, exact facial identity and full-body wardrobe/proportions. Reference-sheet labels and white studio backgrounds are not scene elements.

Matching 65mm medium close-up of Halinka on SCREEN RIGHT, looking off-screen LEFT toward seated Czeslaw. Canonical cardigan and jewelry. Her LEFT hand supports the level saucer with the exact sage bundle at lower chest height; right-hand black phone sits lower, screen toward her body. Her face is unobscured by smoke; thin plume trails upward away from her eyes. Same position as master, no other person visible.
Keep the hall roofless and ruined. Preserve all existing visible source lettering and logos on included scene objects; do not transplant reference-sheet annotations. No added people, repaired roof, supernatural light, oversized smoke, illustration, captions, watermark, montage or malformed anatomy. Mouths rest naturally before dialogue. No End Frame is required.
prompts.animation:
0–1s: Halinka looks toward screen left. 1–3s: she makes one small matter-of-fact chin dip and settles; both hands and the sage saucer stay level. Her expression remains warm and sincere, lips relaxed for later synchronization. Camera: locked-off, one continuous shot. Secondary motion: natural breathing and minor fabric settling only; the thin smoke rises only from the sage tip and disperses in daylight. Continuity: preserve the exact identities, anatomy, costumes, props, ruined architecture, daylight and any visible lettering from Start Frame. Avoid new people, duplicate objects, extra limbs, face morphing, cuts, fades, captions and watermarks.
